anthropic.description: These options apply only to supported Anthropic API models, not Claude CLI.

extendedCache.label: Extended prompt cache (1 hour)
extendedCache.hint: Keep reusable prompt prefixes cached for longer.

contextEditing.label: Server-side context editing
contextEditing.hint: Trim older tool results while preserving the cached prefix.

toolSearch.label: Native tool search
toolSearch.hint: Let supported Anthropic models discover deferred tools on the server.

programmaticTools.label: Programmatic tool calls
programmaticTools.hint: Run tool orchestration in the provider container. Local code mode is a separate capability; permission checks still apply.

webTools.label: Server-side web tools
webTools.hint: Enable provider-hosted search and page retrieval for agents with tools enabled. Usage may incur additional charges.

compaction.label: Server-side compaction
compaction.hint: Compact long tool loops on the server. Client-side conversation compaction remains separate.

refusalFallback.label: Refusal fallback
refusalFallback.hint: Use the configured API fallback for supported Fable/Mythos requests.

taskBudget.label: Autonomous task budget (tokens)
taskBudget.hint: 0 disables the API task budget. Supported adaptive models use at least 20,000 tokens when enabled.

shell.label: Shell access
shell.hint: Allow agents to run commands through the application shell. Applies to all workspaces after saving.

codeMode.label: Local code mode
codeMode.hint: Let the native agent loop call MCP tools through generated Python bindings. Requires shell access; tool permission checks still apply.
codeMode.warningBody: Enable Shell access above to make this capability available.

scope.suffix: . The theme changes when you switch workspaces. Changes are previewed immediately; choose Save to make them permanent.

theme.label: Theme color
theme.hint: Choose a color and its light or dark variant; the entire interface updates immediately.

appearance.resetTitle: Return this workspace's appearance to the application-wide default
appearance.customStatus: This workspace uses a custom appearance

autonomous.description: These controls apply to autonomous work. Interactive conversations are unaffected.

confine.label: Confine autonomous file operations
confine.hint: Restrict supported file tools to the working directory and block git push. Shell commands and arbitrary scripts can still access other paths; this is not a sandbox.

checklist.label: Autonomous startup checklist
checklist.hint: Remind autonomous agents to orient themselves, verify a baseline, complete one task and close the loop.

continue.label: Continue unfinished autonomous work
continue.hint: Resume unfinished autonomous turns automatically. Manually stopped or guard-limited runs are excluded.

background.description: Productive work has no total duration cap. Idle windows detect stalled runs.

concurrent.label: Concurrent background sessions
concurrent.hint: Maximum background sessions running at the same time (1–128).

queued.label: Queued background sessions
queued.hint: Maximum sessions waiting for available capacity (1–128).

flowRetention.label: Completed flow runs to retain
flowRetention.hint: Finished flow runs (one per turn) kept per agent; 0 = unlimited. Older ones are pruned every 10 minutes.

perTurn.label: Background sessions per turn
perTurn.hint: Maximum sessions an agent can start in one turn (1–64).

idle.label: Background idle window (minutes)
idle.hint: Cancel a background, worker or scheduled run after this long without meaningful progress. Productive runs have no total duration cap.

chatIdle.label: Chat idle window (minutes)
chatIdle.hint: Cancel an interactive turn with no meaningful steps. Network heartbeats do not count. 0 disables the limit.

codexIdle.label: Codex output idle window (seconds)
codexIdle.hint: Idle window for the Codex subprocess output stream.

recovery.label: Idle recovery attempts
recovery.hint: Maximum automatic resume attempts after an idle interruption.

watchdog.label: Turn watchdog window (minutes)
watchdog.hint: Idle window used by the turn watchdog.

hooks.label: Forward hooks to Claude CLI
hooks.hint: Run workspace hooks through the CLI. Commands must be compatible with the CLI shell.

persistent.label: Persistent process
persistent.hint: Keep one CLI process alive per session and send only new messages.

resume.label: Resume
resume.hint: Start a process per turn and resume the previous CLI session. Available for single-agent conversations.

off.label: Off
off.hint: Start a new process with the full transcript each turn. Useful for diagnostics; increases input usage.

promptFile.label: Pass the system prompt through a file
promptFile.hint: Use a temporary file to avoid command-line length limits with large prompts.

toolAllowlist.label: Limit Claude CLI built-in tools
toolAllowlist.hint: Expose only the built-in tools needed by the bridge to reduce prompt overhead.

researchAgents.label: Claude CLI research agents
researchAgents.hint: Allow native Explore and Plan agents. Delegation to TionHarness agents stays separate.

auxRouting.label: Use Anthropic API for auxiliary calls
auxRouting.hint: Route supported title, summary and other tool-free system calls through an available Anthropic API instance. These calls use API billing instead of the CLI subscription.

intro.middle: in the chat box to open the command palette. To send a command as plain text, enclose it in quotation marks:

commands.deterministic: This command is deterministic. It does not use a model or prompt; the result is generated directly at runtime.
commands.autoTitleHint: Not a command — generates conversation and task titles

contextHandoff.description: Resume long autonomous tasks in a fresh context. Manual handoff remains available independently.

auto.label: Automatic context handoff
auto.hint: Start a fresh session when an autonomous turn reaches the context limit. Manual chat is unaffected.

maxChain.label: Maximum handoff chain
maxChain.hint: Maximum consecutive resets before falling back to regular compaction.

writeFile.label: Write a handoff file
writeFile.hint: Also write .tionharness/handoff.md in the working directory.

save.label: Save progress to disk
save.hint: Persist the task checklist so it can be reused across sessions.

restore.label: Restore progress in new sessions
restore.hint: Load unfinished progress when a new session has no checklist of its own.

contextRecovery.description: Recovery controls for the native provider loop. CLI providers manage their own loops.

compact.label: Compact after context overflow
compact.hint: Summarize older messages and retry when the context window overflows.

continue.label: Output continuation attempts
continue.hint: Continue responses that reach the output limit. 0 keeps the partial response without retrying.

recent.label: Recent messages to retain on recovery
recent.hint: Messages retained verbatim during reactive compaction (2–50).

outputLimit.label: Output token limit
outputLimit.hint: 0 selects a model-specific limit. A positive value applies a fixed cap.

retries.label: Provider retry budget
retries.hint: Retry temporary provider errors within a turn (0–5). Permanent authentication or quota errors are not retried.

coordinatorLimits.description: Worker capacity and nesting limits for multi-agent coordination. Automatic turns and total subtree sessions remain unlimited.

workers.label: Workers per coordinator
workers.hint: Maximum active workers for each coordinator (1–64).

depth.label: Coordinator depth
depth.hint: Root depth is 0. Use -1 for unlimited nesting.

grace.label: Report grace period (seconds)
grace.hint: Wait this long after a branch becomes idle before sending a missing completion report. Allow enough time for synthesis.

detect.label: Detect stalled coordinators
detect.hint: Use a judge and periodic checks to recover coordinators that claim to have started workers without actually starting them.

window.label: Stall check window (minutes)
window.hint: 0 uses the default window; -1 disables periodic checks while retaining the turn-end guard.

nudges.label: Consecutive recovery nudges
nudges.hint: Maximum corrective nudges before reporting a visible failure. 0 uses the default.

notes.label: Show recovery notes in chat
notes.hint: Only controls visibility. Recovery notes are always recorded and passed to the coordinator.

delegation.description: Limits for synchronous agent delegation. Individual tool availability is managed in the Tools screen.

depth.label: Maximum delegation depth
depth.hint: Maximum nesting for synchronous agent delegation (1–10).

perTurn.label: Delegations per turn
perTurn.hint: Maximum synchronous delegation calls in one user turn (1–100).

record.label: Record diagnostic events
record.hint: Record per-session timing, token usage, tool outcomes and recovery events.

retain.label: Diagnostic events to retain
retain.hint: Keep the newest events per session. 0 uses the default of 5,000.

keepAwake.label: Keep screen awake
keepAwake.hint: Prevent the screen from sleeping while the app is open. Applies to all workspaces after saving.

autoTitle.label: Generate titles automatically
autoTitle.hint: Name new conversations and tasks automatically.

autoTag.label: Tag sessions automatically
autoTag.hint: Add tags for errors, goals, completion and archival. Manual and agent-applied tags remain available.

hooks.title: Tool hooks (PreToolUse / PostToolUse)
hooks.description: Hooks run an external command around tool calls in the native provider loop. PreToolUse can change, approve or block input; PostToolUse can transform output or add context. The command reads JSON from stdin and returns JSON on stdout; exit 2 blocks the call. Claude CLI hooks also run in the CLI's own shell when forwarding is enabled.
hooks.codexWarningTitle: Hooks do not run for codex-cli agents
hooks.codexWarningBody: codex-cli runs its tool loop in a separate process and does not support hook forwarding. These hooks will not fire for codex tools or TionHarness tools called through the MCP bridge. PostToolUse token optimizers such as sqz are therefore unavailable to codex-cli agents.

eventHints.userPrompt: before prompt — add context or block

options.userPromptSubmit: UserPromptSubmit (before prompt — add context or block)

hooks.matcherHint: Tool events: tool-name glob (empty = all, e.g. Bash, Write, http_*). SessionStart: source (startup|resume). PreCompact: trigger (manual|auto). Other lifecycle events: leave empty.
hooks.commandHint: Shell command (Windows: PowerShell). Reads JSON from stdin and returns JSON on stdout.

builtins.title: Built-in behaviors (read-only)
builtins.description: Hooks automatically injected around the TionHarness tool loop. They cannot be edited; some can be toggled by their related setting.

floor.label: Maximum context tokens — FLOOR
floor.hint: The lower bound for the budget: it can only raise the budget, never lower it. To shrink the window, lower the Budget ceiling instead.

ceil.label: Budget ceiling (tokens) — UPPER LIMIT
ceil.hint: The upper bound for the budget and the setting to change when shrinking the context window. Lowering it clips the effective budget; raising it keeps more raw history at the cost of recall precision.

fraction.label: Window fraction
fraction.hint: Share allocated to the transcript (0–1). 0 selects the recommended adaptive value for the model family.

formula.suffix: ). A fraction of 0 is adaptive; an unknown window uses the floor.

rolling.label: Rolling (TionHarness)
rolling.hint: When the budget is exceeded, the oldest turns are folded into TionHarness's rolling summary while the rest of the transcript is sent verbatim.

native.label: Native (CLI)
native.hint: Leave compaction to the CLI provider. Native compaction drops the warm CLI session, so the next turn starts cold.

auto.label: Automatic
auto.hint: Use native compaction when the provider supports it and a warm CLI session is live; otherwise use rolling compaction.

scope.title: Application-wide setting:
scope.body: This setting applies to all workspaces. Each workspace's data is periodically saved to its own zip archive. Older archives are pruned automatically. Backups are written to the backups/ folder in the data directory by default.

auto.label: Automatic backups
auto.hint: When enabled, every workspace is backed up at the selected interval. The first backup runs after one interval.

interval.label: Backup interval (hours)
interval.hint: Time between automatic backups (at least 1 hour). 24 means once per day.

retain.label: Backups to retain
retain.hint: Number of newest archives kept per workspace; older ones are pruned (at least 1).

folder.label: Backup folder
folder.hint: Leave empty to use backups/ in the data directory. You can enter an absolute path.

backup.note: Changes to interval and retention settings apply after Save. Back up now uses the saved settings.

archives.title: Available backups ({{count}})
archives.warning: Restoring replaces all current data in the selected workspace with the archive and cannot be undone. The workspace is closed and reopened from the archive during the operation.
archives.empty: No backups yet. Use Back up now to create the first one.

externalTools.description: Checks whether optional CLI tools used with TionHarness are installed on this device. Path overrides are checked first, then PATH. Tools are not installed, run or modified. Hook tools can be connected with one click; MCP and CLI tools are shown with an information badge.
externalTools.updateCheckHint: Compare installed tools with the latest GitHub releases. Results are cached for 6 hours.
externalTools.bypassCacheHint: Skip the cache and query GitHub again
externalTools.createHookHint: Create and enable a TionHarness hook for this tool
externalTools.settingWireHint: This tool is connected through a workspace setting. Only measured test and build commands are rewritten.
externalTools.mcpHint: MCP-based — add it under Settings ▸ MCP
externalTools.providerHint: Runs an LLM provider — configure it under Settings ▸ Providers
externalTools.cliHint: Plain CLI invoked directly by agents

cbm.title: codebase-memory integration:
cbm.description: When the MCP server is added, TionHarness provides agents with workspace-isolated code graph search and indexes the working directory automatically.
cbm.mustBeOnPath: This tool must first be found on PATH
cbm.connected: MCP server added — agents can use it.

token.title: Token optimization integration:
token.description: When rtk or sqz is connected, TionHarness tells the agent that output is shortened automatically. Hook matchers must cover Bash and PowerShell.
token.enableBothDetail: — rtk shapes the command before execution and sqz compresses the output afterwards; measurements show that stacking performs best.

maintenance.clearCacheHint: Clear the sqz dedup cache while keeping statistics.
